changes: - **End-face registration** (`EndFaceRegistration` in `ObjectPointAccumulator`): each scan's visible end face (belt band, 10th/90th x percentile) is shifted onto the median of the track's last 10 faces (gated at 12 returns and 0.5 m); the last 10 scans stay raw and are re-voxelized when the reference moves. Moving cars' end faces no longer arrive as 0.4-0.6 m slabs. The live estimator passes the sensor position per scan.

- **Calibrated type posterior**: types rank by 0.5 x N x ln(robust cost / best robust cost) with N the occupied coarse surface cells (<= 48), plus box-dimension NLL, plus 0.1 x parameter prior. Sweeps refine the best 3 screened types, every type within 3 nats of the box-size optimum (unless its screen is hopeless) and the incumbent. A per-track `TypePosterior` (decay 0.7, informative sweeps only) adopts the argmax of a tentative type at a 1-nat lead and leaves a confident one (p >= 0.8 after 2 sweeps) only after a 3-nat lead on two consecutive informative sweeps; freezing waits for a confident type. Below 150 voxels the type never switches, a new track takes the box-size type unless beaten by 3 nats, and only size parameters are fit.

- **Visible-end features** (`TopProfile`): the observed upper envelope per 0.25 m bin from the visible end gives a rise distance (end top to roof step; 0 for SUV/minivan tails, ~1.3 m sedan trunk, ~1.8 m pickup bed), scored against each type's own profile (sigma 0.3 m). Where the roof would have been in view (sensor 0.2 m above it and not shadowed by nearer tops along the sensor rays) a model center-line top more than 0.1 m above the observed top costs (negative evidence).

- **Road layer removal**: when the snapped box floor sits below the road, the surviving dense road layer is dropped before fitting (and from held-out scoring), so it no longer drags clearance and ends.

- Sedan dimension exemplars gain Corolla, Elantra and Sentra (compact sedans were scored as hatchbacks by size alone). Box dimensions alone now pick the labeled type for 29/48 (group 38/48); with the v3 priors it was 23/48 (36/48).

- Tried and reverted (each worsened held-out p90 by 0.007-0.02 m on the dev frames): 1-sigma trust on trunk/rear-glass/bed landmarks, 0.5x weight and 15 cm cap on inside returns, +-10 cm end / +-5 cm ground limits, freezing clearance. The held-out-scan acceptance check was not implemented.

- Harness: the type-mean column is now the **box-dimension-only** type (the gain from LiDAR shape evidence is the difference to the fitted column); held-out distances are also reported with frame t registered onto the accumulation (frame t's own GT-box jitter, up to 0.5 m on movers, otherwise dominates sedan p90s); new columns face_spread_m, rise_x_m, dims_type, label, type_correct, type_trace; captions come from `body_labels.json`. Live scheduling is still not replayed (every scan is refit).
